title: Production Performance, Scalability & Load-Integrity Audit
decision_phrase: STAGE 26 decision: YELLOW — two D-class defects (negative/non-numeric pagination limit and deeply-nested JSON both returning HTTP 500) were reproduced, root-caused, minimally fixed with regression tests, and re-verified with a full 433/433 regression; one measured C-class finding remains (bcryptjs password hashing runs on the main event loop, up to ~800ms cross-user latency under 8 concurrent auth attempts). No load-induced corruption, XP ledger exactly correct, no duplicate/lost rewards, no cross-user leakage, no resource leaks, no unbounded list behavior.
final_regression: 433/433 (43 files) — 426 baseline + 7 new pagination/deep-nesting regression tests

complexity.feed: O(n) seq-scan + sort before index; O(log n)+limit after posts(created_at) index
complexity.leaderboard: O(n) seq-scan + sort (COALESCE + LEFT JOIN prevents index-only ordering)

hot_row_contention.scenario: same user completing same quest 50x concurrently — all touch user_levels.total_xp row
hot_row_contention.result: serialized on row lock; exactly 1 award + 49 idempotent replays; no deadlock, no timeout

connection_pool.config: pg Pool default max = 10 (no env override in code)
connection_pool.observation: 500 concurrent completions queue on the pool: p50 1.37s, elapsed 1.9s (~260 req/s throughput)

query_plan_index_audit.feed: Seq Scan posts + Hash Join + Sort (O(n log n)); FIXED with posts(created_at DESC) index: 20.2ms -> 0.34ms (60x)
query_plan_index_audit.leaderboard: Seq Scan user_levels + Hash Join + Sort; total_xp index tested but only 1.6x (still sorts) — NOT added (write overhead on every XP award outweighs gain)

nplus1: feed = 1 query, conversations = 1 query, personalized feed = 1 query; no parent+N-children loops found

pagination.defect: limit=-1 and limit=abc returned HTTP 500 (negative/NaN passed to SQL LIMIT/OFFSET)
pagination.fix: parseLimit/parseOffset sanitize non-finite and negative to safe values; regression-tested

payload_limits.deeply_nested_5k: 500 -> FIXED to 400 (recursive stripNullBytes RangeError -> iterative traversal)

sse.cleanup: fd count returns to baseline (~25) within seconds of abort; no leak
sse.isolation: membership check per connection; existing sse-auth tests pass

rate_limit.note: max=120/10min (mutation) and max=10/15min (auth) enforced under concurrency
rate_limit.classification: INFRASTRUCTURE-DEPENDENT: express-rate-limit MemoryStore is per-process (not global across instances)

auth_performance.finding: C — bcryptjs (pure JS) hashes on the main thread; concurrent auth degrades unrelated requests
auth_performance.recommendation: migrate to native bcrypt (libuv threadpool) or argon2; or offload to worker thread

ai_resilience.classification: UNTESTED (live Groq timeout/slow/failure) — GROQ_API_KEY not set; fallback code path verified: deterministic endpoints remained deterministic across all load tests

cache_hot_path.finding: no explicit cache layer; repeated requests hit PostgreSQL; determinism tests pass; no stale/cross-user data observed

memory_leak.rss_stabilized_mb: ~220-240 (plateau, no monotonic growth across load/idle cycles)

failure_under_load.pool_error_handler: present (db/index.ts attaches pool.on('error') to avoid crash on PG restart)
failure_under_load.live_pg_restart_test: not performed (embedded PG restart disrupts shared cluster)

browser_performance.classification: NOT EXECUTED / INFRASTRUCTURE-DEPENDENT — no Chromium in sandbox; web app requires same-origin proxy to API (deployment infra not replicated locally)

optimization_before_after.principle: only posts(created_at) index added (measured 60x win); total_xp index rejected (1.6x, high write overhead)
